messages:
elaine: Postmortem posted for the 03/20 cache spike — TL;DR: recurring eviction window every ~48–72h causing tail latency. Need owners for remediation tasks and Jira tickets. Link: https://redwood.in/pm/RED-INC-2026

samir: I can take the infra side (KV eviction tuning + autoscaler policy). Will create tickets. @jessie can you own the runtime/quantization followups?

jessie: Yep, I can. Will break into two tickets (regression test + runtime config). ETA end of sprint. :thumbsup:

mike: Suggest RACI for the two main action items: R=Samir, A=Elaine, C=Jessie, I=Platform Eng. Also split "monitoring alert" into a separate low-effort ticket.

elaine: Agreed. Can we get Jira IDs in this thread so PMs can link? Need owner handover steps documented for Private customers.

samir: Created RED-2129 (infra: eviction thresholds + autoscale) and RED-2130 (infra: chaos test to reproduce). Commands I ran:
```
/jira create RED-2129 "Infra: tune eviction thresholds"
/jira create RED-2130 "Infra: chaos test for eviction"
```
Links: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/RED-2129

ops-bot: Jira ticket RED-2129 created by samir. Status: Open.

jessie: Created RED-2131 (runtime: kv-cache policy + regression) and RED-2132 (runtime: quantization edge case). Added checklists to RED-2131. Link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/RED-2131

mike: I'll pick up RED-2133 for alerting (low-effort). Assigning to me now.

elaine: Cool — final RACI mapping in thread: RED-2129 R:Samir A:Elaine C:Jessie I:Platform; RED-2131 R:Jessie A:Elaine C:Samir I:Support. Due dates: RED-2129 2026-04-10, RED-2131 2026-04-08. @samir @jessie please confirm.

samir: Confirmed. I'll add a short runbook fragment for Private deploys as part of RED-2129 (owner handback notes included).

jessie: Confirmed. Will add test checklist to RED-2131 and flag any blocking infra.

elaine: Thanks. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up sync for 2026-04-01 to check progress. Calendar invite to follow. :calendar:

mike: FYI — noticed similar pattern in last quarter (logs attached in the PM). I'll add links to the PM to track recurrence and tag with recurrence-pattern.

elaine: Great. Closing thread for assignments; we'll use the Jira tickets for day-to-day and reopen here if blockers come up. :white_check_mark:
